title: A live Sepolia mandate, rendered from saved run evidence.
help: This page runs no new Sepolia transaction. It selects one completed live run and renders the values the app already wrote to disk during that run, then records the rendering to video.
recording: Rendering the selected run from its saved evidence. The result will be saved in this app's data directory.
unsupported: This browser does not support canvas recording in WebM format.
failed: The recording stopped before it finished. Nothing was saved.
bindingRefused: Recording not saved. The server refused to bind it to this run ({code}). Missing: {missing}.
noRuns: No live run was found in this app's data directory.
liveUnavailable: The live Sepolia workspace is not enabled. Start the app with --live.
missingValue: Recording refused. The saved run is missing: {value}.
idlePrompt: Choose a run, then press record. The canvas fills in once recording starts.
footer: Rendered from this run's saved evidence, after the run. No transaction is sent while recording.
closing: Every value on this screen comes from the app's saved live journal and evidence for this run, rendered after the run.
apiTxIdNote: This is a Brickken API tracking id. It is not an Ethereum transaction hash.
replayNew: A new agent transaction was seen.
replayNone: No new agent transaction was seen.

labels.apiTxId: Brickken transaction id (not a chain hash)

missing.runNotCompleted: confirmation that the selected run is completed
missing.ownerApproval: the owner's approval time for this run
missing.stepEvidence: the confirmed {step} transaction (hash, block number and verification)
missing.apiTxId: the Brickken transaction id recorded for execute
missing.replay: a replay observation for the execute operation
missing.finality: a finality result showing every step finalized

steps.title: One completed Sepolia run, replayed from evidence.
steps.body: Nothing here sends a new transaction. Every value below was written to disk during the run shown here.

steps.title: The owner approved this exact plan.
steps.body: Approval binds to one plan hash. A changed plan cannot reuse it.

steps.title: Owner setup: three signed writes.
steps.body: setAction, approve and grant were signed by the owner and confirmed on Sepolia.

steps.title: The transaction cap holds at one observed block.
steps.body: Both calls read the same block. The allowed amount succeeds and the larger amount reverts.

steps.title: The agent executed through the MCP tool execute_approved.
steps.body: Brickken's own tracking id is not the Ethereum transaction hash.

steps.title: Replaying the same operation id sends nothing new.
steps.body: The agent's next nonce did not move.

steps.title: The remaining cumulative budget was checked too.
steps.body: Both reads use the same block, after the executed transfer.

steps.title: The owner revoked the mandate once.
steps.body: The same calldata that executed earlier now reverts after revocation.

steps.title: The allowance was reset, and every step reached finality.
steps.body: approve(0) closes the executor's allowance. Finality is checked on both read endpoints.

steps.title: The evidence for this run is saved to disk.
